_comment: Starter practice config for the management-consultant vertical. A WORKED EXAMPLE, not a recommendation or a benchmark: every number here is invented and must be replaced with your own before any gate result means anything. Run Stage 0 to derive them.

disqualifiers.reason: pressure to start without a written scope
contact must check with an unnamed party
prior suppliers described as incompetent with no self-implication
desired outcome changed between conversations — require a paid discovery phase
no executive sponsor identified above the day-to-day contact

_walk_away_note: Must equal the walk_away_day_rate computed by economics.py --floor from the costs, capacity and risk blocks above.
